summary: Keep the source task as a fresh exact deferral and do not create an omnibus ConRAC portfolio company. Direct evidence confirms that iCON and Conrac Solutions announced a five-year project-equity and refinancing partnership in November 2020, and the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton quick-turnaround facility is the only specifically verified iCON-backed project. Direct airport and company records verify historical iCON equity financing and Conrac Solutions' development and operating roles but do not identify AVP QTA LLC's legal members, iCON fund or vehicle, stake, co-owners, retained interests or current status. Conrac Solutions is a separate corporate platform currently owned by Meridiam; EWR and Reno are separate project boundaries. No direct record identifies one common legal investee behind the iCON label, a complete portfolio roster, partnership renewal or termination, or treatment of iCON project interests in the Meridiam transaction.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The direct Conrac Solutions partnership announcement corrects the date to 2020-11-09 and defines the scope as equity financing for future privately delivered and refinanced ConRAC facilities over five years, not a disclosed purchase of the Conrac Solutions corporation.
The direct Conrac Solutions AVP page verifies that financing provided by iCON closed in August 2022 and the facility opened in October 2023.

The direct AVP airport release identifies iCON Infrastructure LLP as historical equity provider, Conrac Solutions units as development, financing and operating parties, and the airport as lessor under a 25-year lease, preserving role separation.

A&O Shearman's direct experience record confirms a separate 50% Conrac Solutions transaction and Related joint venture, later sale of the Conrac Solutions business to Meridiam, and distinct EWR equity arrangements without identifying iCON as a corporate or EWR owner.

Meridiam and Conrac Solutions direct materials confirm Meridiam's current corporate ownership, while exposing an unresolved May-versus-June 2023 acquisition-date reference and no legal-party, acquired-subsidiary or rollover schedule.
The direct Reno project page verifies a separate Meridiam-backed project for which Meridiam supplied the entire equity and financial close occurred in May 2024.
US InfraVest's direct portfolio page separately labels Conrac Solutions and EWR ConRAC as exited and identifies the EWR investor group without establishing an iCON interest or AVP exit.

Preserve Conrac Solutions Parent, LLC as the separate Meridiam-owned development and operating platform; AVP QTA LLC, EWR ConRAC LLC, Reno and other airport facilities remain individual project boundaries.
